messages:
ava: Heads-up — CloudHarbor wants a connector listing + launch the week of Apr 12. proposal: joint connector benchmark blog, short webinar, and marketplace how-to. timeline?

rachel: Need product signoff on the connector beta. product says it will be feature-flag gated. +1 for prerecord demo. :white_check_mark:

tom: Eng update: connector image + e2e test harness ready. can run perf suite for median 512-token loads. 24h synthetic run ETA 48h.

vivek: I’ll own webinar content (slides + registration). partner prefers Wed mornings PT. recommend 45m slot: 25m demo + 15m Q&A + 5m wrap.

nina: Marketing: I’ll do blog, socials, and a sales 1-pager. need a tight narrative (e.g., '2x throughput vs baseline') or we lead with integration simplicity. need partner logo + brand guide.

ops-bot: Reminder: do NOT share PII or raw customer logs with partner. use consent checkbox and redaction. see https://confluence/redwood/privacy-guidelines#marketplaces

eng-bot: Perf job kicked off. raw results posted to s3://redwood-partners/cloudharbor/bench/2890012345/results.csv

ava: Inbound leads: partner asks that marketplace leads go to their CRM, but we must mirror a lead into SFDC and attach utm_campaign and consent. any concerns?

tom: Routing proposal: marketplace -> partner webhook (minimal fields), and mirror -> Salesforce Lead mapping: LastName, Company, Email, LeadSource=Marketplace_Partner, UTM_Campaign, Use_Case__c. include consent boolean.

rachel: Legal cleared the consent copy: "I agree to be contacted by CloudHarbor and Redwood about this integration." partner signed the POA.

vivek: Webinar scheduled: Wed Apr 14 10:00am PT. format: prerecord demo + live Q&A. registration page must be live by Apr 7. reminder cadence: +3 days, +1 day, +1 hour.

nina: SEO checklist for benchmark post: meta title with "CloudHarbor connector", H1 with keyword, two charts (latency and cost / 1k tokens), embed 2–3min highlight clip from webinar, and add structured data for article.

ava: Action owners + due dates:
- tom: perf run complete + raw logs + methods note (due in 2 days)
- vivek: webinar page + slides + speaker rehearsal (due in 7 days)
- nina: blog draft + social copy + sales 1-pager (due in 5 days)
- rachel: legal copy + partner assets + consent wording (due in 3 days)
- tom: lead-routing spec + sample webhook + token rotation plan (due in 2 days)

tom: sample webhook payload (to partner):
```
POST /hooks/cloudharbor HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.cloudharbor.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>
{
  "first_name": "Ava",
  "last_name": "Lee",
  "company": "BetaLtd",
  "email": "ava.lee@betaltd.com",
  "utm_campaign": "ch-launch-2026-04",
  "consent": true
}
```

ava: SFDC note: auto-create Lead and associate with CampaignId = CH-LAUNCH-2026-04. add tag partner:cloudharbor and field Lead_Source__c = "Marketplace: CloudHarbor". set validation to require consent=true before export.

nina: can we get a 30s quote from partner CTO for the blog? partner said yes, will follow up.

ava: final sync scheduled Fri 9:00am PT to review landing, sample webhook, and promo calendar. drop blockers here before EOD. :rocket:
